_meta.description: Machine-readable registry of every ReloPass test campaign. One entry per campaign. Never modify a past entry — add new ones only. Used by campaign_scorer.py for historical trending and by the relopass-test-campaign skill for campaign labelling.

fields.label: Human-readable label assigned by Romain at campaign close (e.g. C1)
fields.date: ISO-8601 date the campaign was run (YYYY-MM-DD)
fields.results_file: Relative path to the raw test_results_*.json for this campaign
fields.report_file: Relative path to the campaign_report_*.json for this campaign
fields.overall_score: Weighted overall score as a percentage (float)
fields.delta: Score change vs previous campaign (null for first campaign)
fields.regressions: Count of tests that regressed vs previous campaign
fields.fixed: Count of tests fixed vs previous campaign
fields.new_failures: Count of new failures not seen in previous campaign
fields.notion_synced: Whether Notion AI Work Queue was updated (true/false/null=skipped)
fields.notes: Free-text notes from Romain about this campaign context

campaigns.label: C1
campaigns.notes: Baseline campaign. Platform at MVP stage. Authentication registration blocked (B18 partially resolved). T13/T14 flows blocked by B2 (admin user creation API). Most infrastructure tests pass.

campaigns.label: C4
campaigns.notes: Full platform audit. 60/65 API PASS. Both 'failures' = test artifacts (HP2 wrong-endpoint false positive; T5 transient 10s timeout under 429). Phase 2 browser audit (all 3 roles) surfaced 5 degraded/cosmetic issues, zero blocking. 4 new Notion tasks (AUDIT-0608-1..4); 2 findings already tracked (Supabase-auth-400=368887c6, Companies-tiles-0=378887c6).

campaigns.label: C5
campaigns.notes: First campaign after the security hardening sprint (SDEF-01..06 RLS) + FRIDAY-003c Data-API opt-out. KEY RESULT: RLS read-isolation INTACT — RLS0–RLS4 all PASS, no tenant-isolation regression from the migrations. The −14.4 drop is ONE root-cause regression, not 11 bugs: POST /api/hr/cases/{id}/assign returns a CONDITIONAL 500 (CT4 PASS→500, C4→C5) — prime suspect the 20260611 relopass_api RLS barrier / FRIDAY-003c grant on the case_assignments write; runner cascades it into 10 BLOCKED persona flows (T1–T8/T14–T16). T14_ASSIGN succeeded on a fresh case (1184ms) so assign is not globally dead. PERF1 /health = single 8s cold-dyno outlier (flake). HP2/B8 = persistent known test-artifact false-positive (wrong-endpoint, per C4 notes). API-only score 90% (vs C4 94%). Phase 2 UI scenarios T9–T12 not run (gstack Chrome extension unavailable this session); T17 covered by RLS API suite. Notion: 1 P0 created (assign regression 37c887c6), B8/HP2 flagged for task-validator. T13_B9 fixed (admin assignments).  ‖ POST-RUN CORRECTION (same day): the assign 'regression' was NOT real — it was TRANSIENT. The 15:03 run hit the backend ~6 min after the C1.6b prod deploy (~14:57) + under campaign load; CT4 (assign 500), CT5 (assignments non-200) and PERF1 (/health 8s) all failed only in that window and ALL reproduce as 200/working now (assign verified ~15× incl. exact CT4 flow). No code/RLS regression; security sprint clean. The −14.4 was the runner cascading one transient CT4 failure into 10 BLOCKED persona flows. True platform state ≈ C4 (~96%). P0 task 37c887c6 downgraded P0→P3 (false alarm). Residual minor: GET /api/hr/assignments returns {assignments,total} vs runner's bare-array CT5 assertion.  ‖ CONFIRMED 2026-06-12 05:47Z: clean full runner pass (results/test_results_2026-06-12T05-47.json) = 95% (75/79 PASS, 0 BLOCKED). CT4/CT5/PERF1/T14_ASSIGN/RLS0-4 all PASS. Transient confirmed; true platform state ≈95% (≈C4). P0 37c887c6 closed Done.

Platform confirmed launch-ready from API perspective; remaining work is all UI/UX polish (Wave 3 queue).
